data.statement: The miniature dealership makes the product's real origin and desktop scale legible in a single image, producing a stronger click reason than simply placing the same toy on a handsome office desk. Arm B typography works when it names that exact scale contradiction and stays clear of the moving silhouette.
data.decision: Keep the corrected miniature-dealership headline artifact as the slot's only survivor, reject the generic home-office base and ungenerated conference-room concept, and stop after the single causal typography correction.
data.nextAction: Prepare the exact unique Arm B afternoon package, record the standing bounded-experiment approval for that package, run validators and the guarded production dry run, then publish no more than one Pin in this run.
